newsitem.title: UK: Imran Khan, Jemima name son Sulaiman Isa. [CORRECTED 16:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Imran Khan, Jemima name son Sulaiman Isa. [CORRECTED 16:00 GMT]

text.p: Pakistani cricket hero and political hopeful Imran Khan and his English wife Jemima have named their newborn son Sulaiman Isa, a family spokesman said on Wednesday.
Jemima, the 22-year-old daughter of millionaire Sir James Goldsmith, gave birth to the baby boy on Sunday night in London. The spokesman said both were doing well.
The couple married in May 1995 (corrects date of marriage). Jemima converted to Islam and moved to Lahore to help support her husband's political career.
